description: This file defines an abstract base class 'NodeTestCase' used for testing Twig's node compilation. It provides utility methods for setting up environments, compiling nodes, and assertions, primarily for internal testing within the Twig templating system.

classes.name: NodeTestCase
classes.description: An abstract PHPUnit test case class providing utility methods for testing Twig Nodes' compilation.

methods.name: getTests
methods.description: Returns an array of test cases, meant to be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: provideTests
methods.description: Provides test data as an iterable, deprecated in favor of 'getTests'.

methods.name: testCompile
methods.description: Tests the compilation of a Twig Node against expected source code.

methods.name: assertNodeCompilation
methods.description: Performs the assertion that a Node compiles to expected source, with optional pattern matching.

methods.name: getCompiler
methods.description: Returns a Compiler instance, creating one with the current environment.

methods.name: getEnvironment
methods.description: Returns the current environment, creating a new one if not set.

methods.name: createEnvironment
methods.description: Creates a new Twig Environment with an ArrayLoader.

methods.name: getVariableGetter
methods.description: Deprecated method to generate variable getter code strings; use 'createVariableGetter' instead.

methods.name: createVariableGetter
methods.description: Generates PHP code for retrieving a variable from the Twig context.

methods.name: getAttributeGetter
methods.description: Deprecated method to generate attribute getter code; use 'createAttributeGetter' instead.

methods.name: createAttributeGetter
methods.description: Returns PHP code string for getting attributes in Twig.

methods.name: checkDataProvider
methods.description: A PHPUnit BeforeClass method that checks the presence of 'getTests' method and triggers deprecation warning if overridden.
